articles.title: CVC Capital expands secondaries platform with $1.1B M&G commitment
articles.mainIdea: CVC Capital expands secondaries platform with $1.1B M&G commitment
articles.summary: Pitchbook: CVC Capital expands secondaries platform with $1.1B M&G commitment. CVC Capital Partners has committed $1.1 billion to M&G Investments’ 2025 PE secondary fund, acquiring a portfolio of PE stakes, primarily in North American mid-market buyout funds. The commitment forms part of a strategic partnership between the UK asset manager and CVC‘s secondaries unit, CVC Secondary Partners.
